name: Magnum Berhad
summary: Magnum Berhad, an investment holding company, engages in the gaming business in Malaysia. It operates through two segments, Gaming; and Investment Holdings and Others. The company operates and manages a licensed four-digit numbers forecast betting business and its variation games. Its game portfolio includes 4D Classic, 4D Jackpot, 4D Jackpot Gold, and Magnum Life. The company also provides property management, management, and information technology services. The company was formerly known as Multi-Purpose Holdings Berhad and changed its name to Magnum Berhad in July 2013. Magnum Berhad was founded in 1968 and is based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
